_help: Playable races. a = starting attribute bonus, mods = permanent bonuses (same keys as the skill tree, see docs/STATS.md), passive = the racial passive {n, d, mods} (F-35; stat stage 'race'), look = appearance. Read by scripts/Races.cs. look: skin/hair/eyes colours; height/bulk scale the whole body; head = head size (Head bone scale, BodyShape in Avatar.cs); ears = true/'pointy' | 'fox' | 'fin'; horns = true/'curl' | 'dragon' | 'oni'; tail = 'fox' | 'dragon'; wings = 'fae'; tusks, beard, glow (eyes). Attachments are fitted to the skull measured for the helmets (data/avatar.json head _help).

human.d: Adaptable. Extra skill point and a little of everything.

elf.d: Graceful and long-lived. Keen with bows and magic, light on their feet.

dwarf.d: Stout and stubborn. Hard to stagger, tough against fire and poison.

orc.d: Brutal strength and a rage that heals.

halfling.d: Small, quick and lucky. More crits and evasion.

shadowkin.d: Born of the Rift. Shadow damage, life drain, at home in the dark.

drakeling.d: Dragon-blooded. Fire in the veins, scales for skin.

lumen.d: Touched by the old light. Holy power and stronger healing.

beastkin.d: Fox-folk of the wild woods. Quick, sly and sure-footed.

passive.d: Climb fast, jump high and move without a sound.

fae.d: Small winged folk of the twilight courts. Bright magic, frail bodies.

passive.d: Wings carry every leap higher, and mana flows back faster.

undying.d: Risen from the grave with their mind intact. Hard to kill, shunned by the light.

passive.d: Cheats death once every few minutes, and never needs to breathe.

tidekin.d: Sea-folk with fins and gills. Masters of water and cold.

passive.d: Breathe under water far longer and swim fast.

oni.d: Horned mountain giants. Huge strength, a thick hide and a short temper.

passive.d: Power attacks hit far harder and throw foes back; hard to stagger.
